value.rationale: The source identifies a robust-to-step-size but symmetry-dependent nontransverse tree connection. Whether a physically natural perturbation of only the central edge destroys that obstruction is a concrete structural-stability gap. A sign-definite perturbation theorem covering every allowed h (rather than a numerical parameter point) determines its first-order bifurcation orientation. It does not overclaim full-dimensional Morse–Smale restoration.
